review_notes: I read all 30 lines of the file. It introduces no definitions, structures, classes, instances, notation or abbreviations. It has only two theorems. `uniform_index_of_increasing_open_cover` is a Dini-type compactness argument: on a compact space, an increasing open cover indexed by ℕ has one member equal to the whole space. It is proved directly from Mathlib's `IsCompact.elim_directed_cover` and uses Mathlib's `Set`, `IsOpen`, `Monotone` and `iSup` throughout. `uniform_strict_index` applies the first theorem to strict sublevel sets. Neither theorem adds a new representation of a concept, so neither can compete with a Mathlib concept. Whether either result restates an existing Mathlib lemma is a question of standalone theorem duplication, which this rubric explicitly excludes. The rubric therefore has nothing in this file to apply to.
